next_steps.title: 1. Cut the remaining App dependency fanout
next_steps.action: Extract App client/diagnostic fixtures from system_tests/conftest.py into an explicitly loaded App plugin. Keep common tracing and scenario reporting independent. Query configured dependencies and replay real historical base/head selection pairs before changing a gate.
next_steps.acceptance: Native targets lose unintended App imports and action inputs; every existing App fixture caller moves in the same change. Estimate end-to-end benefit from actual affected-target reductions.

next_steps.title: 2. Test two ordinary pytest shards
next_steps.action: Partition the existing Pod cases by compatible state and duration; keep storage inventory checks isolated. Run two standard pytest targets with the same logical assertions and real deployment acceptance, measuring the duplicated setup and worker cost.
next_steps.acceptance: Use only if complete feedback improves and total compute stays within 1.25 of the matched control. Reject if setup duplication or lost concurrency consumes the gain.

next_steps.title: 3. Qualify only a promising candidate
next_steps.action: Compare current required CI with the candidate across 30 matched PR pairs, at least 100 fresh contract executions, three busy windows, warm/cold conditions and a four-PR burst. Include seeded or historical regressions and positive controls.
next_steps.acceptance: At least 30% faster complete required feedback, compute ratio at most 1.25, no unassigned unique assertion or new unexplained isolation/failure signature. Record p90, failures, reruns and unknown metrics.
